text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning many races
together with Winning Ticket—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aargh,
isn't there anything fun to do~?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series has calmed down,
so I wanna go somewhere fun and live it up~!
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, we promised to go to the hot springs.
Come to think of it, we promised to go to the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can still vividly recall the sight of Winning Ticket
bursting with pure joy after pulling the grand prize
at the New Year's lottery.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hot... spring...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaaaaaaargh?!
Hot springs, hot springs, hot spriiiiiiings!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Why did I forget...!
Even though it was such a passionate promise we made!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaaahh!!
I'm so sorry, Trainerrr!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can stay calm!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Even while we're standing here,
the hot springs are waiting for us...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOO!!
Hot springs, wait for me! Here I commmmeeeeeee!!
choice_data_list: A-At least let me get dressed first...!
A-At least let me get dressed...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly finished preparing,
and headed to the hot spring inn with Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuugh... It's a real traditional inn,
a real hot springggg...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We've finally come
this far, haven't we... *sniff*!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After soothing Winning Ticket, who burst into tears
right upon arrival, I tried to head for the hot spring, but—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hoooold on just a second--!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Trying to get into the hot spring without doing that first is a cruel joke, Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yes! When it comes to hot spring inns...
It's time for table tenniiis!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Here I goooooo~~~~~!!
Ticket-zo's ultimate explosive SMASHHHHHH!!!!!
choice_data_list: (The ball's going completely off course again...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Winning Ticket and I worked up a sweat playing table tennis.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaaaay!
Hot springs are the absoooolute best!!
choice_data_list: Okay, okay, just keep it down a bit.
Okay, okay, I'll be a little quieter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To help calm her nerves,
I prepared a drink, but—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
T-That's...!!
The classic post-bath coffee milk?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaay!!
Time to dig iiiiiiiiiin--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems that only ended up
exciting them even more.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!
This is definitely what hot springs are all about!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, table tennis, hot springs, and coffee milk...
I have zero regrets left in life, yesss!!
choice_data_list: There's still a feast waiting for us.
There's still a feast waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hah! That's right!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Bounties of the sea, treasures of the mountains!
Such lavish hospitality, this is truly—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uuuuugh! Everything I've worked so hard for up until now was worth ittt...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After savoring the inn's gourmet cuisine,
Winning Ticket came to visit my room.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whew, I ate so much♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The food was so delicious
that I went back for seconds and thirds!
choice_data_list: I'm glad we could come here.
I'm glad we could come here.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll never forget the Twinkle Series,
nor will I ever forget today!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The race where we gave it our all,
the hot spring trip where we had fun to the fullest—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooooooon!!
Both of 'em are the best memories eveeeeer~!!
choice_data_list: Let's win the race and make even more memories!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You're right...!
Our challenge is far from over!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Let's run in lots more hot races!
And then come soak in the hot springs a ton!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All riiiiight!
Let's keep up the great work, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hip, hip, hooraaaaay!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond
with Winning Ticket...
